name: BG Modern Asymmetry House
author: SimsWithNora
style: Four stepped tiers on a lake lot: a teal-brick garage podium, a raised main floor reached up an exterior stair between stepped timber planters, three dark timber bays, an octagonal plunge pool on the podium roof, corner balconies with timber rails and two offset dark-timber penthouse boxes with copper ends, all under thin dark flat roofs
